title: One chat request
summary: Shows who wants to talk, with their trust facts, before the person answers. Accept opens the chat; decline removes the request; decline and block also stops the person from writing again; report sends it to the Bipe team.

accountAge.description: unverified only: how long ago the account was created, already formatted by the system ("3 dias").

nameMismatch.description: The verified name when it differs from the name the person saved in the address book (ADR 0018).

isWorking.description: true while accept, decline or report runs.

confirmBlock.description: true while the decline-and-block dialog is open.

error.description: true after a failed action. Shows bipe_error_generic.

nameWarning.description: From BipeRelationshipNames: none without a verified name and a known contact match; mismatch for a differing full name; confirm for an unconfirmed family label or nickname.

accept.effect: Joins the room, then opens chat-timeline. The chat moves to the chat list.

decline.effect: Leaves the invited room. The request goes away; the inviter sees nothing special.

declineAndBlock.effect: Leaves the room and adds the inviter to the ignore list.

report.effect: Reports the room to the Bipe team, leaves it, and shows bipe_dm_reported_and_left.

isSamePerson.description: The answer to the local nickname question.

confirmNickname.effect: Stores the answer on this phone for this account, inviter, saved label and verified name. Yes clears only the nickname warning. Unsure leaves a caution and does not ask again for the same pair. A changed saved label or verified name asks again.

notes: No message text before accept: a Matrix invite carries no messages. The screen shows the person, not their first message.

Trust block, in order: the verified name (bipe_badge_verified_name) or, for an unverified account, bipe_banner_unverified_title, bipe_banner_unverified_body with accountAge, and bipe_request_unverified_body. An external account shows bipe_banner_external. Move, do not rewrite: BipeKit BipeTrustProfile.swift, BadgeVerifier.swift, NameNormalizer.swift; libraries/bipe BipeTrustProfile.kt, BadgeVerifier.kt, NameNormalizer.kt.

nameMismatch (ADR 0018): a differing full saved name uses the danger treatment. A family label or one-word nickname uses caution and asks once. The shared registry relationship-names.json supplies the policy. The comparison runs locally against contact matches already obtained with permission; opening a request sends no address book. Keep names in memory per account and hide this check when contact access is revoked. Store only a digest of the account, inviter, saved label and authenticated verified name with the answer.
The handle shows as @handle under the name when bipe-api resolves one (BipeHandleResolver).
Photo: hidden when bipe_privacy_requests_hide_photos is on (chat-requests).
Decline uses a plain leave, so the inviter can ask again later. Decline and block adds the ignore; the server then drops new invites from that person.
Report: Room.reportRoom with no reason text, then leave. bipe_dm_decline_report_description says where it goes.
Accept, decline and decline and block work offline-first: the request leaves the box at once; a failure brings it back with bipe_error_generic.

accountAge and personal verified-name lifecycle facts are optional and require an authenticated public source. Omit unavailable facts; never derive an age from an invite timestamp or treat a profile name as verified. Company names may use a company seal that verifies against the inviter master key.
